$comment: Renderer layout registry. Adding a layout requires a matching builder in app/rendering/templates.py.

hero-full.description: Full-bleed photograph with a gradient scrim; copy stacked in the lower half.

banner-lower-third.description: Photograph in the upper two thirds, solid brand band carrying the copy below.

split-diagonal.description: Angled split between photograph and brand colour. High energy.

offer-badge.description: Heavily darkened photo, centred copy stack, circular offer badge.

before-after.description: Two stacked panels labelled BEFORE / AFTER with copy beneath.

stat-stack.description: Typographic layout with up to three proof points. Photo optional.

hero-editorial.description: Full-bleed aerial photography, giant two-tone headline with one accented word, a row of pill chips, and a combined CTA + phone pill at the base. The house style extracted from the operator's reference flyers.
